item.title: Qarakal Quantum Unveils Pangaea Architecture for Modular Quantum Computing
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Quantum startup Qarakal Quantum today announced its Pangaea architecture for breakthrough modularity and scalability that shortens the path to commercially viable, industry-scale quantum computing. Leveraging its IP-protected quantum bus technology, Qarakal Quantum constructs quantum computers from specialized modules and interconnects, maintaining fault tolerance with 1/10th of the required qubit count of traditional approaches.
